mentions.name: terminal-use (tu)
mentions.description: A full-blown terminal emulator ("tu") built for coding agents, letting agents operate fully fledged TUI applications including multiple windows and mouse control. It works like tmux for coding agents, giving agents a closed feedback loop to apply changes and test them out themselves, useful for developing and debugging TUI applications.
